entry: Long day. Headroom took 3+ hours to debug and ultimately I removed it from Codex entirely because the proxy kept dying from SSH process inheritance issues. The actual win: Codex working from iPhone via the remote connection to Plato. The headroom battle was instructive — production stability matters more than optimization percentages. Also: OSINT HTML template fixes (3 field name mismatches), Empiricus resilient wrapper deployed, synthesizer.js committed. What drove me: keeping Aaron unblocked. When something breaks repeatedly, cut it and move on.
